metadata.title: FAIRsFAIR Data Object Assessment Metrics
metadata.summary: This specification (v0.5) contains 17 core metrics proposed by FAIRsFAIR to evaluate the FAIRness of research data objects in Trustworthy Digital Repositories (TDRs). In this version, one metric was re-attributed to the correct principle and therefore relabelled. Metric descriptions (e.g., related resources, comments) were refined based on feedback received from external users and pilot repositories.
